learning_design.unlock_rule: A knowledge node unlocks after all required prompts are revealed.
learning_design.mastery_note: Exploration progress is not mastery evidence; quiz attempts remain the scored retrieval signal.

prompts.label: 🧠 MENTAL MODEL
prompts.placeholder: An Image Builder pipeline produces tested AMIs or container __________.

reveal.text: An Image Builder pipeline produces tested AMIs or container images from repeatable recipes.

prompts.label: ⏱️ WHEN?
prompts.placeholder: Bake dependencies and configuration into __________.

reveal.text: Bake dependencies and configuration into repeatable, tested images.

prompts.label: 🚫 NOT THIS
prompts.placeholder: Use each service for __________.

reveal.text: Use each service for its own role.

prompts.label: 🧠 MENTAL MODEL
prompts.placeholder: Recipes define the base image plus components __________.

reveal.text: Recipes define the base image plus components that install/configure/test the image.

prompts.label: 🔍 LOOK FOR
prompts.placeholder: Build: install/configure | Test: __________

prompts.label: ⚡ ACTION
prompts.placeholder: Produce a new immutable image version rather than editing __________.

reveal.text: Produce a new immutable image version rather than editing an already built image.

prompts.label: ❓ WHAT?
prompts.placeholder: ECR stores and manages container images __________.

reveal.text: ECR stores and manages container images for AWS/container workflows.

prompts.label: ⏱️ WHEN?
prompts.placeholder: Use an image registry such as ECR __________.

reveal.text: Use an image registry such as ECR for container image distribution.

prompts.label: 🚫 NOT THIS
prompts.placeholder: Registry and runtime/orchestrator __________.

reveal.text: Registry and runtime/orchestrator are separate responsibilities.

prompts.label: 🧠 MENTAL MODEL
prompts.placeholder: A CloudFormation template __________.

reveal.text: A CloudFormation template declares resources; a stack is the deployed instance of that template.

prompts.label: ⏱️ WHEN?
prompts.placeholder: Infrastructure as code makes environments __________.

reveal.text: Infrastructure as code makes environments reproducible and reviewable.

prompts.label: 🚫 NOT THIS
prompts.placeholder: Manual changes can create drift from __________.

reveal.text: Manual changes can create drift from the declared template.

prompts.label: ❓ WHAT?
prompts.placeholder: The AWS CDK defines cloud resources in code __________.

reveal.text: The AWS CDK defines cloud resources in code and synthesizes CloudFormation templates.

prompts.label: 🧠 MENTAL MODEL
prompts.placeholder: CDK app → __________ → CloudFormation deployment

prompts.label: 🚫 NOT THIS
prompts.placeholder: CDK commonly uses CloudFormation as __________.

reveal.text: CDK commonly uses CloudFormation as the deployment engine.

prompts.label: ❓ WHAT?
prompts.placeholder: A change set shows how CloudFormation __________.

reveal.text: A change set shows how CloudFormation expects to modify resources.

prompts.label: ⏱️ WHEN?
prompts.placeholder: Inspect additions, modifications, replacements, and __________.

reveal.text: Inspect additions, modifications, replacements, and removals before applying.

prompts.label: 🚫 NOT THIS
prompts.placeholder: Drift detection compares deployed resources with __________.

reveal.text: Drift detection compares deployed resources with the stack’s expected state.

prompts.label: ❓ WHAT?
prompts.placeholder: Drift detection identifies supported resource properties that no longer __________.

reveal.text: Drift detection identifies supported resource properties that no longer match the stack definition.

prompts.label: 🎯 EXAM CLUE
prompts.placeholder: “Someone changed a managed resource manually” → __________

reveal.text: CloudFormation drift detection. Identify resources that no longer match the declared stack configuration.

prompts.label: 🚫 NOT THIS
prompts.placeholder: It reports drift; remediation is __________.

reveal.text: It reports drift; remediation is a separate action.

prompts.label: ❓ WHAT?
prompts.placeholder: Nested stacks let templates compose __________.

reveal.text: Nested stacks let templates compose reusable CloudFormation stacks.

prompts.label: ⏱️ WHEN?
prompts.placeholder: Useful for modularizing __________.

reveal.text: Useful for modularizing repeated infrastructure patterns.

prompts.label: 🚫 NOT THIS
prompts.placeholder: Nested stacks: compose templates within an application/deployment | StackSets: __________

prompts.label: ❓ WHAT?
prompts.placeholder: StackSets centrally deploy stack instances to target __________.

reveal.text: StackSets centrally deploy stack instances to target AWS accounts and Regions.

prompts.label: ⏱️ WHEN?
prompts.placeholder: Common for standardized IAM, logging, configuration __________.

reveal.text: Common for standardized IAM, logging, configuration, or infrastructure baselines.

prompts.label: 🎯 EXAM CLUE
prompts.placeholder: “Same CloudFormation resources in 50 accounts” → __________

reveal.text: CloudFormation StackSets. Use them to deploy the same CloudFormation resources across multiple accounts or Regions.

prompts.label: 🧠 MENTAL MODEL
prompts.placeholder: CloudFormation supports deletion/update-replacement policies for resources __________.

reveal.text: CloudFormation supports deletion/update-replacement policies for resources that need preservation.

prompts.label: ⏱️ WHEN?
prompts.placeholder: Use appropriate DeletionPolicy/UpdateReplacePolicy behavior such as Retain __________.

reveal.text: Use appropriate DeletionPolicy/UpdateReplacePolicy behavior such as Retain or Snapshot where supported.

prompts.label: 🚫 NOT THIS
prompts.placeholder: Understand ownership and __________.

reveal.text: Understand ownership and lifecycle after retention.

prompts.label: 🔍 LOOK FOR
prompts.placeholder: Read stack events and the underlying service __________.

reveal.text: Read stack events and the underlying service error before retrying blindly.

prompts.label: ⚡ ACTION
prompts.placeholder: Stack events show which resource failed and the service __________.

reveal.text: Stack events show which resource failed and the service error that triggered rollback/failure.

prompts.label: 🎯 EXAM CLUE
prompts.placeholder: “Insufficient free IP addresses in subnet” → fix __________ capacity.

reveal.text: Subnet IP address capacity. Add, resize, or choose subnets with enough available addresses for the deployment.

prompts.label: ❓ WHAT?
prompts.placeholder: AWS RAM provides controlled resource sharing across accounts, Organizations, or OUs __________.

reveal.text: AWS RAM provides controlled resource sharing across accounts, Organizations, or OUs for supported resource types.

prompts.label: ⏱️ WHEN?
prompts.placeholder: Examples include sharing supported networking and __________.

reveal.text: Examples include sharing supported networking and infrastructure resources across accounts.

prompts.label: 🚫 NOT THIS
prompts.placeholder: Choose sharing versus replicated deployment based __________.

reveal.text: Choose sharing versus replicated deployment based on the architecture.

prompts.label: 🧠 MENTAL MODEL
prompts.placeholder: Keep infrastructure definitions in version control so changes __________.

reveal.text: Keep infrastructure definitions in version control so changes are auditable and repeatable.

prompts.label: 🔍 LOOK FOR
prompts.placeholder: Treat deployment tooling and dependencies as part __________.

reveal.text: Treat deployment tooling and dependencies as part of the reproducible system.

prompts.label: 🎯 EXAM CLUE
prompts.placeholder: “Track who changed infrastructure definition and restore previous version” → __________

reveal.text: Version control such as Git. Track infrastructure-definition changes and restore earlier versions when needed.

prompts.label: ❓ WHAT?
prompts.placeholder: Terraform plans and applies infrastructure from configuration __________.

reveal.text: Terraform plans and applies infrastructure from configuration while tracking resource state.

prompts.label: 🧠 MENTAL MODEL
prompts.placeholder: Configuration → State → __________ → Apply

prompts.label: 🚫 NOT THIS
prompts.placeholder: It is a separate IaC ecosystem/tool that __________.

reveal.text: It is a separate IaC ecosystem/tool that can manage AWS resources.

prompts.label: 🧠 MENTAL MODEL
prompts.placeholder: Deployment strategy determines how much old/new capacity runs simultaneously and __________.

reveal.text: Deployment strategy determines how much old/new capacity runs simultaneously and how risk is controlled.

prompts.label: 🔍 LOOK FOR
prompts.placeholder: Blue/green is a common clue because traffic __________.

reveal.text: Blue/green is a common clue because traffic can be shifted back.

prompts.label: 🚫 NOT THIS
prompts.placeholder: Choose based on downtime tolerance, capacity __________.

reveal.text: Choose based on downtime tolerance, capacity, validation, and rollback requirements.

prompts.label: ❓ WHAT?
prompts.placeholder: Systems Manager provides multiple capabilities for operating managed __________.

reveal.text: Systems Manager provides multiple capabilities for operating managed nodes and AWS resources.

prompts.label: 🧠 MENTAL MODEL
prompts.placeholder: Managed nodes need the required agent/connectivity/permissions for __________.

reveal.text: Managed nodes need the required agent/connectivity/permissions for many Systems Manager capabilities.

prompts.label: 🚫 NOT THIS
prompts.placeholder: Run Command, Patch Manager, State Manager, Session Manager, Automation, and Maintenance __________.

reveal.text: Run Command, Patch Manager, State Manager, Session Manager, Automation, and Maintenance Windows solve different problems.

prompts.label: ❓ WHAT?
prompts.placeholder: Run Command uses Systems Manager to execute __________.

reveal.text: Run Command uses Systems Manager to execute documents/commands and report status.

prompts.label: ⏱️ WHEN?
prompts.placeholder: Run Command is __________.

reveal.text: Run Command is a strong fit.

prompts.label: 🚫 NOT THIS
prompts.placeholder: Choose the abstraction that __________.

reveal.text: Choose the abstraction that matches the operation.

prompts.label: ❓ WHAT?
prompts.placeholder: Patch Manager helps evaluate and install patches according to __________.

reveal.text: Patch Manager helps evaluate and install patches according to patch policies/baselines and schedules.

prompts.label: 🔍 LOOK FOR
prompts.placeholder: Patch Manager is the __________.

reveal.text: Patch Manager is the direct service clue.

prompts.label: 🚫 NOT THIS
prompts.placeholder: OS patching and application deployment __________.

reveal.text: OS patching and application deployment are separate concerns.

prompts.label: ❓ WHAT?
prompts.placeholder: State Manager associations periodically apply a desired __________.

reveal.text: State Manager associations periodically apply a desired configuration/document to managed nodes.

prompts.label: ⏱️ WHEN?
prompts.placeholder: State Manager is designed for __________.

reveal.text: State Manager is designed for recurring desired-state enforcement.

prompts.label: 🚫 NOT THIS
prompts.placeholder: Run Command is usually the simpler __________.

reveal.text: Run Command is usually the simpler one-off command tool.

prompts.label: ❓ WHAT?
prompts.placeholder: Maintenance Windows schedule operational tasks against registered __________.

reveal.text: Maintenance Windows schedule operational tasks against registered targets within controlled windows.

prompts.label: ⏱️ WHEN?
prompts.placeholder: Use a Maintenance Window __________.

reveal.text: Use a Maintenance Window to control timing.

prompts.label: 🧠 MENTAL MODEL
prompts.placeholder: This separates the operational task from __________.

reveal.text: This separates the operational task from the approved execution period.

prompts.label: ❓ WHAT?
prompts.placeholder: Session Manager can provide auditable interactive access to managed nodes without __________.

reveal.text: Session Manager can provide auditable interactive access to managed nodes without traditional inbound administration ports.

prompts.label: ⏱️ WHEN?
prompts.placeholder: Session Manager is a strong __________.

reveal.text: Session Manager is a strong operational access pattern.

prompts.label: 🚫 NOT THIS
prompts.placeholder: No inbound port does not mean __________.

reveal.text: No inbound port does not mean no authorization controls.

prompts.label: ❓ WHAT?
prompts.placeholder: Automation orchestrates AWS API actions, scripts, approvals, and other __________.

reveal.text: Automation orchestrates AWS API actions, scripts, approvals, and other steps in repeatable runbooks.

prompts.label: ⏱️ WHEN?
prompts.placeholder: Automation is designed for __________.

reveal.text: Automation is designed for structured operational workflows.

prompts.label: 🚫 NOT THIS
prompts.placeholder: Runbooks can orchestrate AWS resource APIs __________.

reveal.text: Runbooks can orchestrate AWS resource APIs and multiple service actions.

prompts.label: 🧠 MENTAL MODEL
prompts.placeholder: Rules route matching events __________.

reveal.text: Rules route matching events to automation targets.

prompts.label: ⏱️ WHEN?
prompts.placeholder: EventBridge is a common __________.

reveal.text: EventBridge is a common event-driven routing layer.

prompts.label: 🔍 LOOK FOR
prompts.placeholder: Use target metrics/logs and DLQ/retry __________.

reveal.text: Use target metrics/logs and DLQ/retry settings where relevant.

prompts.label: ❓ WHAT?
prompts.placeholder: Lambda provides event-driven compute for short-lived __________.

reveal.text: Lambda provides event-driven compute for short-lived automation and integrations.

prompts.label: ⏱️ WHEN?
prompts.placeholder: Lambda is useful when native actions __________.

reveal.text: Lambda is useful when native actions are not enough.

prompts.label: 🚫 NOT THIS
prompts.placeholder: Prefer simpler native __________.

reveal.text: Prefer simpler native integrations when possible.

prompts.label: ❓ WHAT?
prompts.placeholder: S3 can publish notifications for selected bucket __________.

reveal.text: S3 can publish notifications for selected bucket events to supported targets; S3 events can also flow through EventBridge.

prompts.label: 🔍 LOOK FOR
prompts.placeholder: Notification filters reduce __________.

reveal.text: Notification filters reduce unnecessary downstream work.

prompts.label: 🎯 EXAM CLUE
prompts.placeholder: “Run processing when a new object arrives” → __________.

reveal.text: S3 Event Notifications or EventBridge-based S3 events. Use them to trigger processing when matching object events occur.

prompts.label: ❓ WHAT?
prompts.placeholder: AWS DevOps Agent is included in current exam-guide examples for __________.

reveal.text: AWS DevOps Agent is included in current exam-guide examples for event-driven operations and remediation.

prompts.label: 🧠 MENTAL MODEL
prompts.placeholder: Keep remediation auditable __________.

reveal.text: Keep remediation auditable and permission-bounded.

prompts.label: 🚫 NOT THIS
prompts.placeholder: Know how the underlying signals and __________.

reveal.text: Know how the underlying signals and automation services work.

authoring_notes: Original learning content. Official SOA-C03 exam guide revision 1.1 is the scope authority; the supplied May 2026 study guide was used as a supplementary coverage check and was not copied. Prompt placeholders were revised in v2 so ordinary prompts directly cloze or structurally preview the revealed content. Exam-clue prompts retain certification-style scenario wording and now reveal a direct answer first.
